entities.summary: Persian, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Median and Achaemenid Empires (499 BCE–330 BCE). Preceded by Darius I builds Persepolis and reorganizes the empire into 20 satrapies and Cyrus the Great conquers Babylon and issues the Cyrus Cylinder. Their legacy influenced Battle of Thermopylae and Salamis and Alexander the Great defeats Darius III and burns Persepolis.
